questions.de: Das Wort „Wodka“ leitet sich wahrscheinlich vom russischen Wort voda ab, aber was bedeutet das auf Deutsch?
questions.en: The word "vodka" probably derives from the Russian word voda, but what does that mean in English?

timeline.labelEn: Earliest written mention of vodka being distilled, in Sandomierz in the Kingdom of Poland
timeline.labelDe: Erste schriftliche Erwähnung von gebranntem Wodka, in Sandomierz im Königreich Polen

questions.notes: Wodka is a diminutive of the Slavic word for water ('little water'); the Polish form is woda.

questions.en: Which costume designer created the horned helmets for the first performance of Wagner's "Der Ring des Nibelungen" in 1876, starting the myth of horned Vikings?

timeline.labelEn: First complete performance of Wagner's Ring cycle at Bayreuth, in costumes by Carl Emil Doepler
timeline.labelDe: Erste vollständige Aufführung von Wagners Ring in Bayreuth, in Kostümen von Carl Emil Doepler

questions.notes: True/false removed. The card's statement is false: Viking Age texts and finds show no horned helmets; the image is a 19th-century invention popularised by Wagner productions (en.wikipedia 'Horned helmet').
